brief:
Israeli forces shot and killed a 32-year-old Palestinian man, Shadi Ahmad Ibrahim Ajarma, near the Nabi Yunis junction north of Hebron in the occupied West Bank late Friday, according to the Palestinian health ministry, Middle East Eye reported. The incident occurred in an area that has seen repeated Israeli military operations.

No further details about the circumstances of the killing were immediately available.

title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian man in West Bank
